prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Columbus. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Columbus Ohio for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — do you mean Columbus, Ohio? A few quick clarifying questions will help me give specific names you should call:

- Which Columbus zip code or neighborhood is most convenient for you? (North, downtown, Clintonville, Westerville, etc.)
- Are you an adult or is this for a child/teen?
- Do you prefer Invisalign specifically, or are you open to traditional braces/clear ceramic brackets?
- Any insurance plan or budget constraints I should consider?

If you want to proceed right away, I can either:
- look up the top-rated orthodontists in your specific area who are experienced with Invisalign and list phone numbers and why each is a good fit, or
- give general guidance now on how to choose an orthodontist and exactly what to ask when you call.

What would you prefer? If you confirm Columbus, OH and give one or two of the details above, I’ll pull a short, targeted list (3–6 recommended offices) with reasons to call each.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
